title: Sprint-interval versus moderate-intensity exercise: mitochondrial remodelling in men
core_idea: To compare how different exercise intensities (sprint-interval versus moderate-intensity continuous) regulate mitochondrial remodelling, ultrastructure, and stress-response and quality-control pathways in men using an open-label, counterbalanced randomized controlled trial.
tldr: A controlled trial comparing sprint-interval and moderate continuous exercise in men to investigate intensity-dependent effects on mitochondrial ultrastructure, stress responses (UPRmt/ISR), quality-control pathways, and related proteomic and respiratory measures.
